proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12918 saṃdhyā gives Gujarati sā̃j and Marathi sā̃j(h) evening. Nimadi sānjā and Bhil hānj are compared jointly in that evening family; initial h in the Bhil forms is a working regional s/h correspondence. The combined evening/afternoon survey gloss is preserved. Exact survey form sānjā is preserved.
